answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on commit-reveal work receipts, forfeited on duplicate submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the orchard until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the anchor of the next round. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the relic of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
